recipe.name: Papaya Plum Yoghurt Bowl with Hemp and Walnuts
instructions: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl and whisk in the whey protein powder until smooth.
Top with sliced plum, diced papaya and blueberries.
Sprinkle over chia seeds, ground flaxseeds and chopped walnuts.
Serve immediately.

recipe.name: Chicken, Edamame and Charred Corn Salad with Lentils and Grapefruit
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, pan-sear in a dry non-stick skillet over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through; rest then slice.
In the same pan, sauté garlic, onion and shiitake mushrooms for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Char the corn kernels in a hot dry pan for 2-3 minutes until lightly blackened in spots.
In a large bowl combine lentils, edamame, charred corn, sautéed mushroom mixture and grapefruit segments.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, salt and pepper for the dressing and toss through the salad.
Top salad with sliced chicken breast and scatter torn basil leaves over the top before serving.

recipe.name: Grilled Chicken and Charred Corn Mexican Bowl with Lentils and Brown Rice
instructions: Rub chicken breast with garlic, chili powder, salt and a little lime juice; grill on high heat 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Char corn kernels in a dry hot pan or on the grill until lightly blackened.
Warm the cooked brown rice and lentils together in a pan, toss with sautéed onion.
Slice grilled chicken and plate over rice-lentil mixture with charred corn.
Drizzle olive oil and remaining lime juice, top with fresh cilantro.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Garlic-Basil Boiled Eggs with Lentil and Corn Salad
instructions: Boil the egg for 8-9 minutes, cool, peel, and halve.
Mince garlic and mix with cooked lentils, corn, chopped basil and lemon juice.
Season lightly and serve the lentil-corn salad alongside the halved egg.

recipe.name: Sardine, Garlic and Onion Pâté on Whole-Grain Toast

ingredients.name: Tinned sardines in olive oil, drained

instructions: Mash sardines with a fork in a bowl.
Mix in diced red onion, minced garlic, lemon juice and chopped basil.
Toast the bread and spread the pâté on top.
Serve with grapefruit segments on the side.

recipe.name: Indian Tandoori Roast Turkey Thigh with Brussels Sprouts and Onion

ingredients.name: Tandoori spice blend (paprika, cumin, coriander, turmeric)

instructions: Mix yoghurt, garlic, ginger, tandoori spices and lemon juice; marinate turkey thigh at least 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 220C. Toss Brussels sprouts and onion with olive oil.
Roast turkey thigh and vegetables together on a tray for 22-25 minutes, turning once, until turkey is cooked through and sprouts are charred.
Rest 3 minutes, slice turkey and serve with roasted sprouts and onion.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Toasted Soybean and Pumpkin Seed Snack
instructions: Combine roasted soybeans and pumpkin seeds in a small bowl.
Serve as a crunchy snack mix.

recipe.name: Lentil and Corn Baked Beans on Toast
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add lentils, cannellini beans, sweetcorn and tomato passata; simmer 8 minutes.
Off heat, stir the whey protein powder into the bean mixture until dissolved.
Toast the bread and pile the bean mixture on top.
Garnish with torn basil and serve.

recipe.name: Thai Braised Pork and Shiitake Mushroom in Basil Broth
instructions: Sear pork cubes in a hot pot until browned on all sides.
Add onion, garlic and shiitake mushrooms; sauté 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and fish sauce, bring to a simmer, cover and braise gently for 15 minutes until pork is tender.
Stir in chili and lime juice, remove from heat, fold in fresh basil and rest 5 minutes before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Grapefruit Yoghurt Cup
instructions: Stir whey protein into a small portion of Greek yoghurt until smooth.
Top with a few grapefruit segments and serve chilled.

recipe.name: Scrambled Eggs and Smoked Salmon with Shiitake on Toast
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and shiitake mushrooms in half the butter until soft and golden.
Whisk eggs and add to the pan with remaining butter; scramble gently.
Fold in smoked salmon pieces just before eggs finish setting.
Toast the bread and top with the scramble.
Garnish with chopped basil and serve.

recipe.name: Japanese Miso Turkey and Shiitake Curry with Brown Rice
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a small pot until soft.
Add turkey cubes and brown lightly, then add shiitake mushrooms.
Whisk miso, curry powder and soy sauce with 150ml water; pour into pot and simmer covered 12-15 minutes until turkey is cooked and sauce thickens.
Drizzle sesame oil at the end and serve over a small portion of brown rice.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Papaya and Cottage Cheese Protein Bowl
instructions: Dice papaya into small cubes.
Stir whey protein into cottage cheese until smooth.
Top cottage cheese with papaya cubes and serve.

recipe.name: Cocoa Plum Protein Shake with Oats and Spinach
instructions: Add water, protein powder and creatine to a blender.
Add plum, oats, spinach and cocoa powder.
Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Greek One-Pan Chicken with Brussels Sprouts, Onions and Basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 210C. Toss Brussels sprouts, onion and garlic with half the olive oil, spread on a tray with chicken thighs.
Season chicken with oregano, salt and pepper, roast 20-22 minutes until chicken is cooked and sprouts are charred at edges.
Scatter olives and feta over the tray in the last 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice, remaining olive oil and fresh basil before serving.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Onion and Basil Seasoned Boiled Egg
instructions: Boil egg for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Halve egg and drizzle with olive oil.
Top with finely chopped spring onion, basil and a pinch of sea salt.

recipe.name: Brussels Sprout and Blueberry Yoghurt Bowl with Almonds

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts, finely shredded and blanched

instructions: Blanch shredded Brussels sprouts in boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and cool.
Whisk whey protein powder into the yoghurt until smooth.
Fold the cooled Brussels sprouts through the yoghurt.
Top with blueberries, strawberries and papaya.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds, chopped almonds and cinnamon before serving.

recipe.name: Korean Beef and Shiitake Mushroom Stir Fry with Brown Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat, stir fry beef strips 2 minutes until browned.
Add garlic, onion and shiitake mushrooms, stir fry 2-3 minutes.
Add corn, soy sauce and gochujang, toss to coat and cook 2 minutes more.
Serve over warm brown rice, sprinkle with sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Soybean, Shiitake and Pumpkin Seed Trail Mix
instructions: Slice dried shiitake thinly and bake at 160C for 8-10 minutes until crisp.
Spread brown rice thinly on a tray and bake alongside until crunchy, about 10 minutes.
Combine roasted soybeans, pumpkin seeds, crisped shiitake, crisped rice and chopped dried plum.
Toss whey protein powder through the mix to coat lightly and portion into a small bowl.

recipe.name: Mackerel, Mushroom and Grapefruit Pâté on Toast

ingredients.name: Tinned mackerel in olive oil, drained
Shiitake mushrooms, finely diced and sautéed

instructions: Sauté onion, garlic and shiitake mushrooms until softened and lightly golden; cool slightly.
Mash mackerel in a bowl and mix in the sautéed vegetables.
Stir in chopped basil and lemon juice.
Toast the bread and spread the pâté generously on top.
Serve with grapefruit segments alongside.

recipe.name: Middle Eastern Grilled Lamb Chops with Brussels Sprouts, Lentils and Grapefruit
instructions: Rub lamb chops with cumin, garlic, salt and half the olive oil; let sit 5 minutes.
Grill lamb chops over high heat 3-4 minutes per side to medium.
Toss Brussels sprouts with remaining olive oil and char in a hot pan or under the grill until browned, about 10 minutes.
Warm cooked lentils with sautéed onion.
Plate lamb with sprouts and lentils, top with grapefruit segments, mint and a squeeze of lemon juice.

recipe.name: Brown Rice, Plum and Soy Yoghurt Bowl
instructions: Whisk whey protein into Greek yoghurt until smooth.
Fold in cooked brown rice.
Top with sliced plums and chopped walnuts, then serve.
